_comment: FACTORY DEFAULTS for the self-hosted update/config endpoints. The fork feeds updates from its own GitHub release assets: updateServerUrl resolves to <base>/latest-linux.yml (and the per-platform variants) plus <base>/latest.json, all of which .github/workflows/build.yml publishes with every v* tag (electron-builder writes the latest-*.yml files, the release job adds latest.json). Operators can still override this in Settings > System > Software Update (persisted in <userData>/self-hosted-update.json) or with the NETCATTY_UPDATE_SERVER_URL override; values here apply only when neither is set. See docs/self-hosted-update-and-config-server.md for the file layout the server must serve.
